title: Write 13 · 您 送 分 笑 汽 兴 忘 边 半 气 火 果 玩 帮 站
focus: 您 送 分 笑 汽 兴 忘 边 半 气 火 果 玩 帮 站
body:
Feelings and outings: 高兴, 笑, 忘, 玩, 帮忙, 车站.

## Repeating parts
- **心 / 忄 heart**: under 您 and 忘. On the left of a character it is 忄, as in 忙.
- **气 air**: by itself, and inside 汽 (氵 + 气).
- **木 tree**: under 果.
- **王** (jade) on the left of 玩. Its bottom stroke tilts up into a ㇀.

## Rules that matter here
- **Centre before sides:** in 半, the 丷 goes first and the long 丨 goes last. In 火, the two side dots come before 人.
- **辶 last:** 送 and 边.

cards.Notes: 你 you over 心 heart: a respectful "you". 11 strokes. Write 你 (7) first, then 心 (丶, ㇃, 丶, 丶) underneath.

cards.Prompt: ＿给 · sònggěi · to give as a gift
cards.Notes: 关 + 辶 walk. 9 strokes. Write 关 first (丶, 丿, 一, 一, 丿, ㇏), then 辶 last.
八 split apart over 刀 knife: to cut into parts. 4 strokes: 丿, ㇏, then 刀 (㇆, 丿).

cards.Prompt: 开玩＿ · kāi wánxiào · to joke
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo + 夭 yāo. 10 strokes. ⺮ is 丿, 一, 丶 written twice. Then 夭 (丿, 一, 丿, ㇏).
氵 water + 气 qì air (sound and meaning): steam. 7 strokes. 氵 (丶, 丶, ㇀), then 气. 汽 is steam or vapour; plain 气 is air.
Top: 丶, 丶, 丿 (three short strokes). Then 一, then 八 (丿, ㇏). 6 strokes. Read xīng in 兴奋 (excited). Lookalike 关 (丷 + 天).
亡 wáng lost (phonetic) over 心 heart: gone from the heart. 7 strokes. 亡 (丶, 一, ㄴ), then 心. Compare 忙 máng (busy): same parts, but 忄 on the left.
力 (a shape only here) + 辶 walk. 5 strokes. 力 first (㇆, 丿), then 辶 last. Lookalike 过 guò has 寸 inside.
5 strokes: 丷 on top (丶, 丿), two 一, then one long 丨 through the middle, written LAST.
Rising vapour. 4 strokes: 丿, 一, 一, then the ㇈ fold-hook. Simplified from 氣 (the 米 was dropped). Lookalike 乞 qǐ (3 strokes).
Flames. 4 strokes: the left 丶, the right short 丿, then 人 (long 丿, ㇏). At the bottom of a character it becomes 灬 (热, 点).
Fruit (田) on a tree (木). 8 strokes. Write the 日 frame (丨, 𠃍, 一, 一), then 木's 一, then its 丨 from the top straight down, then 丿, 丶.
王 jade + 元 yuán (phonetic). 8 strokes. 王 on the left (一, 一, 丨, ㇀; the last stroke rises). Then 元 (一, 一, 丿, 乚).
邦 bāng (phonetic) over 巾 cloth. 9 strokes. 邦: 一, 一, 一, 丿, then 阝 (㇌, 丨). Then 巾 (丨, 𠃌, 丨).
立 stand + 占 zhàn (phonetic). 10 strokes. 立 (丶, 一, 丶, 丿, ㇀; the last stroke rises), then 占 (丨, 一, then 口).
